article.hook: You notice how compassion suddenly refuses limits - giving more than you knew you had. Pluto in Pisces moves power through imagination and empathy so fluidly it breaks your usual grip on control.
article.lived: For about two decades, this transit stretches our sense of influence beyond rules and walls. We find power in dissolving boundaries - through art, dreams, and collective care that slips past logic. In daily life, it’s the person who transforms conflict by imagining a new outcome instead of fighting, or the community that rebuilds after crisis by sharing stories and hopes rather than plans.
article.turn: But when compassion blurs into obsession, control sneaks back dressed as surrender. Escaping reality feels safer than facing hard truths, and power becomes a means to avoid pain rather than meet it. You can’t reshape what you won’t confront - letting boundaries fade doesn’t erase what needs standing firm.
moves: Read a poem or song that rewires how you see struggle and healing.
Offer a practical help that insists on clear boundaries, not vague promises.
Create a small ritual that marks the end of an old story and invites a new perspective.
